notes:
Account expansion: existing Redwood customer (hosted API for analytics/embeddings) looking to consolidate contact-center stack.
- Vertical: BPO + in-house enterprise support for two large retail clients.
- Primary ask: agent assist (real-time suggestions), post-call summarization, 1-click tool-calls into Salesforce and internal ticketing, and high reliability during Black Friday-style spikes.
- Latency target: agent assist avg generation <200ms tail <350ms for 95th pct.
- Throughput: 600 concurrent active agents, peak 1400 requests/sec during spikes.
- Cost sensitivity: moderate; willing to pay for Dedicated pools if unit economics clear. Wants Optimize recommendations for batching + quantization.
- Model preferences: open to Llama-family quantized variants for cost, but legal/security requires private deployment option for EU client workloads. Ask: model pinning and versioned rollouts.
- Quote from Dir. of Ops: "Tool-calling must be reliable — agent loses trust after 2 failures."
- Integration notes: heavy Salesforce integration; want webhook-based action confirmations and idempotency. Also wants proofs for audit trail retention (7 years for regulated clients).
- Existing infra: uses GCP EU-west for sensitive clients, AWS-us for others. Keen on VPC peering + Private control plane.
- Internal stakeholders: CTO (platform), Dir Ops (buyer), Security lead (legal + compliance).
- Financial: target ARR expansion across two accounts; pricing sensitivity around per-token costs during spikes.
